text:
Nina (PM): quick post-launch triage — consolidated follow-on list from the support desk + telemetry: 1) embeddings semantic drift for long-tail docs, 2) streaming chunk re-order on unstable networks, 3) dashboard spike in 99th percentile latency for reranker. Need to decide hotfix vs next sprint.
Alex: can you scope severity?
Nina (PM): embeddings: one enterprise customer reported similarity drop on multi-paragraph docs after model swap; search relevance impacted. Streaming: rare reorder on mobile when cell handoff happens; sometimes tokens arrive out-of-order. Latency: p99 spikes aligned with medium-size batches hitting dedicated pools.
Priya: embeddings sounds correctness -> must-fix. We should gate model swap and run a targeted regression vs customer corpus.
Sam (SRE): p99 spike looks like bursty GC on a subset of nodes. I captured heap profiles. We can throttle mid-size batches as a temporary mitigation.
Alex: streaming reorder — urgent but not correctness. Short-term: add seq numbers in chunk envelopes and a client reordering buffer in SDK. Priya, can you do a small SDK patch?
Priya: yes. Will ship a patch with a 200ms reordering window for mobile beta.
Nina (PM): acceptance criteria:
- Embeddings must-fix: regression test on customer corpus shows similarity >= baseline for 95% of samples OR we revert model in affected pools.
- Streaming urgent: SDK patch + server keepalive deployed and telemetry shows 40% drop in reorder events in 72h.
- Latency p99: SRE to apply throttling rule to reduce burst, and GC patch scheduled in next weekly maintenance. Monitor 48h for improvement.
Sam (SRE): I'll flip a throttling rule for batch-size > 500 on dedicated pools and post telemetry link. build-bot, schedule a canary window at 03:30 UTC for the model rollback test.
build-bot: scheduled canary run for pool-5 at 03:30 UTC. Notifying owners: Priya, Alex, Sam.
Alex: owners: embeddings = Priya + Alex; streaming = Priya; latency = Sam. Nina, will you move these to the hotfix lane on the roadmap?
Nina (PM): moving embeddings + streaming to hotfix lane, latency to "urgent ops". Customer comms: offer routing to hosted API if embedding regression not fixed in 36h and apply 5% service credit.
Priya: will post SDK canary link and minimal curl checks here.
Nina (PM): thanks — follow-up sync 10:00 tomorrow or sooner if canary fails.
